_comment: Hand-written pin angles for the pages in the launch feed (owner-approved daily drip, 16 Oct 2026). Every headline, subline, title and description restates something the target page itself says (product catalog, content registry, hub page data); no prices, so nothing can drift from the live price. Every number used must appear in that page's source text: tests/unit/pinqueue.test.ts checks it. When a page's angles run out, scripts/pinterest/pin_queue.mjs derives further angles from the page's source data.

/printable-wedding-checklist.headline:
Print It.
Work From It.
/printable-wedding-checklist.title: Printable Wedding Checklist: Task, Owner, Due Date, Done
/printable-wedding-checklist.description: A printable wedding checklist you work from by hand: every task from setting the date to the wedding-week handoff, with a line for who owns it, when it is due and whether it is done.

/printable-wedding-checklist.headline:
Every Task,
Owner & Deadline
/printable-wedding-checklist.subline: From the date to the handoff
/printable-wedding-checklist.title: Printable Wedding Checklist: Every Task, Owner and Deadline
/printable-wedding-checklist.description: Every wedding task from setting the date to the wedding-week handoff, with an owner, a due date and a done box. Prints cleanly from your browser and keeps the critical path on a few pages.

/printable-wedding-checklist.headline:
Cross Out What
Doesn't Apply
/printable-wedding-checklist.subline: Then write one owner per line
/printable-wedding-checklist.title: How to Use a Printable Wedding Checklist: Cross Out, Assign, Date
/printable-wedding-checklist.description: Print the checklist, cross out tasks that do not apply, write one owner beside each remaining line, and move contract-based dates into your calendar or working tracker.

/printable-wedding-checklist.headline:
Foundation
First
/printable-wedding-checklist.title: Wedding Planning Foundation: Date, Guest Count, Location, Budget
/printable-wedding-checklist.description: Start the printable wedding checklist with the foundation: date or date window, guest-count range, location or venue search area, budget ceiling and decision owners.

/printable-wedding-checklist.headline:
Booking
& Build
/printable-wedding-checklist.title: Wedding Booking Checklist: Venue, Key Vendors, Guests, Logistics
/printable-wedding-checklist.description: Secure the critical path first: venue and ceremony access, catering, photography and other key vendors, then the guest list, attire, rentals, transportation and lodging.

/printable-wedding-checklist.headline:
Finalize
& Hand Off
/printable-wedding-checklist.title: Finalize and Hand Off: The Last Page of Your Wedding Checklist
/printable-wedding-checklist.description: Stop adding scope and reconcile the wedding that is actually happening: final guest and meal counts, seating data, final balances and receipts, timelines and emergency contacts.

/printable-wedding-checklist.headline:
A Control Sheet,
Not a Contract
/printable-wedding-checklist.subline: Move contract dates to your tracker
/printable-wedding-checklist.title: A Printable Wedding Checklist Is a Control Sheet, Not a Contract
/printable-wedding-checklist.description: The printout is a control sheet, not a replacement for contracts or vendor instructions: transfer contract-based dates into your calendar or working tracker as you go.

/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.headline:
Eloping?
Check the Law First
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.title: Eloping? Check the Marriage License, Waiting Period and Witness Rules First
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.description: An elopement removes guests, not legal requirements. Verify the marriage license rules, any waiting period and the witness rules where the ceremony will actually take place.

/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.headline:
No Guests.
Still Legal Rules.
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.title: Elopement Planning: No Guests, but the Legal Rules Still Apply
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.description: The license, the officiant's authority and the witness rules still decide whether an elopement is a valid marriage. A free checklist for what to confirm before you travel.

/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.headline:
Is Your Officiant
Authorized There?
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.title: Elopement Checklist: Confirm Your Officiant Is Authorized Where You Marry
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.description: Confirm the officiant is authorized in the jurisdiction where the ceremony takes place, and secure any location permit, before booking travel for your elopement.

/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.headline:
Location Permit
Before Flights
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.title: Elopement Planning: Secure the Location Permit Before You Book Travel
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.description: Secure any location permit for the ceremony site before booking travel, then plan photos, attire and the day itself. A free elopement planning checklist.

/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.headline:
Waiting Periods
Vary by Place
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.title: Elopement License Waiting Periods Vary: Confirm With the Issuing Office
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.description: License validity windows, waiting periods and required witness counts vary by jurisdiction and change over time, so confirm the current rule with the issuing office for your location.

/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.headline:
The Elopement
Checklist
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.subline: Then plan photos, attire, the day
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.title: The Elopement Checklist: Legal Steps First, Then Photos, Attire and the Day
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.description: Check the marriage license, waiting period, witnesses, officiant authority and location permits before you travel, then plan photos, attire and the day itself.

/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.headline:
How Many
Witnesses?
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.title: How Many Witnesses Does an Elopement Need? It Depends Where You Marry
/guides/elopement-planning-checklist.description: Required witness counts vary by jurisdiction. Check the witness rules that apply where the ceremony will actually take place, along with the license and any waiting period.

/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.headline:
Courthouse
Wedding Checklist
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.title: Courthouse Wedding Checklist: Start With Your Jurisdiction's Rules
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.description: A courthouse wedding checklist begins with jurisdiction-specific appointment, license, witness, identification, security and photography rules. Verify them directly first.

/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.headline:
Book the
Appointment
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.title: Courthouse Wedding: Reserve the Appointment If Your Courthouse Requires One
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.description: Verify your courthouse's requirements directly, reserve the appointment if one is needed, gather documents and assign witnesses before the day.

/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.headline:
Bring a Printed
Confirmation
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.title: Courthouse Wedding Tip: Bring a Printed Confirmation and a Backup ID Plan
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.description: Keep a printed confirmation and a backup identification plan, because building access and appointment rules vary from courthouse to courthouse.

/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.headline:
Security &
Photo Rules
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.title: Courthouse Wedding Checklist: Security Screening and Photography Rules
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.description: Security screening and photography rules are part of a courthouse wedding plan. Check what your courthouse allows before you invite a photographer or bring extras.

/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.headline:
Assign Your
Witnesses
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.subline: Know the rule where you marry
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.title: Courthouse Wedding: Know the Witness Rule and Assign Your Witnesses
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.description: Witness rules depend on the jurisdiction. Verify the requirement, assign your witnesses, and gather their identification along with your own documents.

/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.headline:
Plan Arrival
& Parking
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.title: Courthouse Wedding Day: Plan Arrival, Parking and the Celebration After
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.description: Plan arrival and parking for the courthouse, then decide what celebration or announcements follow the ceremony. Part of a free courthouse wedding checklist.

/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.headline:
Small Ceremony,
Real Checklist
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.title: Small Courthouse Ceremony, Real Checklist: Appointment, License, ID, Witnesses
/guides/courthouse-wedding-checklist.description: Even a short courthouse ceremony needs a plan: appointment booking, marriage license, witnesses, identification, security screening and photography rules, then the small plans around it.

/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.headline:
Planning a
Destination Wedding?
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.title: Planning a Destination Wedding? Work Each Dependency in Order
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.description: Destination planning adds travel, lodging, local vendor, documentation, shipping and guest-communication dependencies to the normal wedding plan. Work through them in order.

/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.headline:
Rings Go in
Your Carry-On
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.title: Destination Wedding Tip: Keep Rings, Attire and Documents in Your Carry-On
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.description: Keep critical attire, rings, documents, medication and ceremony essentials out of checked-only baggage. One of the steps in a free destination wedding checklist.

/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.headline:
Room Blocks,
Transport, Contacts
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.title: Destination Wedding Checklist: Room Blocks, Transport and Local Contacts
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.description: Confirm room blocks, transport and local contacts for your destination wedding, alongside the ceremony plan, shipping restrictions and weather contingencies.

/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.headline:
Legal or
Symbolic Ceremony?
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.title: Destination Wedding: Decide on a Legal or Symbolic Ceremony First
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.description: Confirm whether the destination ceremony will be legal or symbolic before the rest of the plan depends on it. A free, step-by-step destination wedding checklist.

/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.headline:
Check Shipping
Restrictions
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.title: Destination Wedding Checklist: Check Shipping Restrictions Before You Ship
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.description: Shipping restrictions are one of the extra dependencies a destination wedding adds. Check them, and what must travel in carry-on luggage, before anything is sent.

/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.headline:
Have a Weather
Contingency
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.title: Destination Wedding Checklist: Plan a Weather Contingency
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.description: Weather contingencies belong on every destination wedding checklist, together with room blocks, transport, local contacts and shipping restrictions.

/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.headline:
Travel, Lodging,
Documents, Vendors
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.subline: Nothing left to the week you fly
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.title: Destination Wedding Checklist: Travel, Lodging, Documents and Local Vendors
/guides/destination-wedding-checklist.description: Work through travel, lodging, local vendor, documentation, shipping and guest-communication steps in order so nothing is left to the week you fly.
